description: Golden signals at a glance — request rate, latency, error rate, saturation, ML health, and infrastructure status.

panels.title: API Target
panels.description: Whether the cortex-api scrape target is reachable by Prometheus.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Total HTTP requests per second across all endpoints.

panels.title: Error Rate (5xx)
panels.description: Percentage of HTTP responses that are 5xx server errors.

panels.title: P99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile HTTP request latency across all endpoints.

panels.title: Worker Heartbeat
panels.description: Age of the last worker heartbeat. Alert if > 60s — worker may be stalled.

panels.title: Circuit Breaker
panels.description: Circuit breaker state: CLOSED (normal), OPEN (blocking requests), HALF-OPEN (recovering).

panels.title: Request Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: HTTP requests per second broken down by endpoint. Identifies hot paths and traffic spikes.

panels.title: Request Latency — P95 / P99
panels.description: HTTP request latency percentiles. Red threshold at 500ms indicates SLA risk.

panels.title: HTTP Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of requests returning 4xx and 5xx status codes over time.

panels.title: Requests In Progress
panels.description: Concurrent in-flight HTTP requests. Spike indicates concurrency pressure or slow handlers.

panels.title: Active Predictions
panels.description: Number of ML predictions currently being processed.

panels.title: ML P99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile ML prediction latency. SLA bucket threshold at 250ms.

panels.title: Drift Flagged
panels.description: Number of models currently flagged for drift (challenger_recommended advisory set).

panels.title: ML Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of ML prediction requests returning an error status.

panels.title: Active Suggestions
panels.description: Total number of live trade suggestions currently active across all directions and confidence levels.

panels.title: Kill Switch Events
panels.description: Total kill switch activations. Any non-zero value warrants immediate investigation.

panels.title: ML Prediction Latency — P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: Prediction latency percentiles. P99 > 250ms breaches the SLA bucket boundary.

panels.title: Model Drift Scores
panels.description: Composite drift score (z-score of prediction distribution vs training baseline) per deployed model.

panels.title: DB Connections
panels.description: Number of active database connections to TimescaleDB.

panels.title: Redis Error Rate
panels.description: Rate of Redis operation errors per second.

panels.title: WS Connections
panels.description: Number of active WebSocket connections.

panels.title: Market Feed Subscriptions
panels.description: Number of active market data subscriptions via Upstox feed.

panels.title: Database Query Latency — P95 by Operation
panels.description: 95th percentile database query latency broken down by operation type.

panels.title: Redis Operation Rate by Type
panels.description: Redis operations per second broken down by operation type and status.
